correctness.rationale: Expand f in normalized nested p-adic ball indicators. A character of conductor p^m integrates 1_{p^jZ_p} to p^{-j} for j>=m and 0 otherwise. Summation gives Fourier coefficients a p^{-m}r^{m-1}[A+epsilon Re(Ce^{i(m-1)theta})], A=(1-r)/(1-r/p), C=(1-re^{i theta})/(1-re^{i theta}/p). Trivial coefficient positive because f>=0 and not zero a.e. Bochner positivity becomes sign of dense circle orbit for irrational theta and finite phase grid for rational theta. Direct finite cyclic Fourier sums reproduce the coefficients, and exact p=2 r=3/5 theta=2pi/3 example gives threshold 139/182 and a nonmonotone positive-definite shell profile.
residual_risks: All finite-group tests are corroborative; infinite-group Bochner and shell expansion are the proof.
Threshold is given only within capped epsilon interval [0,1].
